features.name: PTE upload, install, and update in admin center
features.description: Full lifecycle management for per-tenant extensions including upload, installation, and update operations directly in the admin center, bringing these operations to the same place as other app management tasks.
caveats: New PTEs can only be installed immediately or during update window, not targeting next minor or major update
Extension management pages and automation API will be deprecated as of version 30.0 (April 2027)
Should avoid using both old and new experiences simultaneously in same environment

features.name: Flexible deployment schedule for PTE installation
features.description: When installing PTEs from admin center, users can choose between immediate deployment, installation during update window, or for existing PTEs targeting next minor or next major version updates.
caveats: New PTEs cannot target next minor or next major updates
Only existing installed PTEs support next minor and next major scheduling options

features.name: App filtering by type in admin center
features.description: New ability to filter installed apps by different categories including per-tenant extensions, allowing users to get different overviews of the different apps installed on an environment.

features.name: Multiple concurrent PTE schedules
features.description: Ability to have multiple scheduled installations for the same PTE at the same time, for example scheduling version 1.1 for next minor update and version 2.0 for next major update simultaneously.

features.name: Cancel scheduled PTE installation
features.description: Ability to cancel a previously scheduled PTE installation before it executes, available from the app details page with option to confirm the cancellation.

features.name: Environment operations audit page
features.description: Comprehensive audit log showing all PTE installation, update, and scheduling operations performed on an environment with details about app versions, deployment schedules, and operation status.

features.name: S2S app permissions for PTE management
features.description: Simplified permission story for server-to-server apps using admin center APIs to orchestrate PTE installation across customer environments - no longer require in-environment registration and permission sets.

features.name: Early hotfix installation for Microsoft apps
features.description: Customers can now install hotfixes to Microsoft apps installed on their environments early, without waiting for safe deployment rollout, by selecting the hotfix version from the app details page in admin center.
caveats: Bypasses safe deployment which is there for a reason
Should only install hotfix versions when you know a particular version will fix an issue you are affected by
May affect users using the environment, coordination recommended

features.name: Known issues tracking for hotfixes
features.description: Power Platform admin center tracks known issues affecting multiple customers, updates them with build numbers that include fixes, allowing customers to identify and install appropriate hotfix versions from admin center.

features.name: Dev extensions persistence on sandbox
features.description: Dev extensions now remain installed on sandbox environments during lifecycle operations and updates, no longer getting unexpectedly uninstalled unless incompatible with environment changes.
caveats: Dev extensions will still be uninstalled if incompatible with environment changes
